title: Twilight Rescue
desc: Dusk on the meadow. The paddock gate below the hatch is worked by a heavy hay press that slams down on a steady beat, and past it the turf ends at the millpond bank. The barn is back the other way.
hint: Every sheep goes through the gate twice. At the slowest release the press keeps time with the flock, so where you stop the first sheep decides whether the way back is clear.
